title: Combine a balanced loop with fixed-fibre coupled dissipation
statement: For arbitrary real integrable alpha, both Rayleigh/Squire diagonal propagators contract, ||C||<=100 and the whole triangular evolution obeys ||S_alpha(t,s)||<=2+100integral_s^t|alpha|. The first balanced lobe has a constant A plateau of length T/2. Factor pre-plateau, plateau and post-plateau; outer factors<=2+1200AT, while the imported full coupled plateau estimate is polynomially bounded times exp[-c sqrt(nu A)T/2]. With A=2^(8n),T=2^(-3n), sqrt(nu A)T=sqrt(nu)2^n, so norm->0 for EACH FIXED p!=0,p^2+l^2>=2. The same rational zero-return loop also has the neutral-sector echo. Critical p=+/-1,l=0, uniform all-fibre limits and nonlinear inter-sector stability are not proved.
